scope.purpose: Constrain interpretation of the already-authorized experiment before any real future obligation is observed.
may: classify realized outcomes produced by the frozen protocol
separate kernel-law evidence from downstream mechanism localization
may_not: change the selector or qualifying-event rule
change Gamma, q, W, semantic coordinates, evaluator, budgets, stopping rules, or runtime
exclude or substitute a realized future event
scope.precedence: If this interpretation artifact conflicts with Packet 7 or its frozen evaluation rule, Packet 7 governs execution and primary adjudication. This artifact may only narrow narrative claims, never broaden them.

frozen_inferential_units.rule: The three source-fact q-kernel pairs are the independent future-consequence grounding units. The twelve relation-kind surfaces are deterministic lifts and are not twelve independent observations.

primary_kernel_adjudication.domain: the complete frozen q-kernel grounding domain

rules.condition: at least one of the three grounding units is DISTINGUISHED
rules.claim: The realized future obligation distinguishes at least one pair that q safely merged for the known ordinary domain.
rules.notes: Other grounding units may remain NOT_IDENTIFIED; one independently grounded distinction is sufficient for non-inclusion. Complete reporting remains mandatory.

rules.condition: all three grounding units are EQUIVALENT
rules.formal: ker(q) subseteq ker(T_future) on the frozen q-kernel domain
rules.claim: The realized future obligation does not require any distinction removed by q on the complete frozen grounding domain.
rules.notes: This is a realized-domain result, not a universal claim that q is safe for all possible futures.

rules.condition: no grounding unit is DISTINGUISHED and at least one grounding unit is NOT_IDENTIFIED
rules.claim: The realized evidence is insufficient to adjudicate future safety of the quotient on the frozen domain.
rules.notes: NOT_IDENTIFIED must not be recoded as EQUIVALENT, zero, failure, or future safety.

rules.condition: the frozen external selector yields NO_QUALIFYING_OBLIGATION within the authorized horizon
rules.formal: T_future unrealized under the frozen selector
rules.claim: No inference is licensed about kernel inclusion or non-inclusion from this benchmark instance.
rules.notes: No later release may be substituted to rescue the test.

downstream_outcome_tree.condition: DeltaPi_A equals DeltaPi_B on the frozen first endpoint
downstream_outcome_tree.claim: A future-relevant distinction exists, but the frozen reopening/generative mechanism does not convert the preserved distinction into differential reachable corrective possibilities.

downstream_outcome_tree.condition: DeltaPi_A differs from DeltaPi_B in the preregistered treatment-sensitive direction on the frozen first endpoint
downstream_outcome_tree.claim: Preserving the future-required revision distinction changes the reachable corrective possibility space under the frozen semantic operator.

downstream_outcome_tree.condition: fresh external evidence does not validate the generated route
downstream_outcome_tree.claim: The topology expands possibility but the generated continuation fails independent reality contact.

downstream_outcome_tree.requires: fresh external evidence validates a generated route
downstream_outcome_tree.condition: CCA does not license the proposed causal correction
downstream_outcome_tree.claim: Fresh evidence exists, but it does not identify the causal revision strongly enough for commitment.
A correction is warranted at the candidate level but is not authorized for persistent state change.

downstream_outcome_tree.condition: authorized correction persists but downstream viability does not improve
downstream_outcome_tree.claim: The authority pipeline succeeds, but the downstream outcome does not support a viability benefit.

interpretive_separations: conditional A/B COMPARE reachability is mechanism localization, not a second independent future-distinction result
forbidden_post_result_moves: select a favorable subset of grounding units or relation-kind surfaces
replace the first qualifying future event
reweight Phi_path after seeing the result
introduce a scalar A-wins score as the primary result
count deterministic relation-kind lifts as independent replications
use downstream success to retroactively increase authorization authority
modify Packet 7 or its execution rules to accommodate a realized rebound
primary_claim_order: 2. three-unit J_future table and complete twelve-surface report
4. conditional DeltaPi mechanism localization if a future-unsafe merge exists
